instruction: Write an XDP program that inspects network traffic and must enforce anti-spoofing security using BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH map 'mac_ip_auth_map' dropping frames where source MAC mismatches source IP. Forward all other packets with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Define BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH map 'mac_ip_auth_map' with key __u32 (IP) and value unsigned char[6] (MAC)
Verify Ethernet and IPv4 header bounds against data_end
If registered in map, drop packet with XDP_DROP if eth->h_source does not match expected MAC
SEC("xdp") entry point and GPL license declaration
